name: Destroy Identity
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 210, Faiths of Corruption pg. 24
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Destroy Identity (Combat, Critical)
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 210, Faiths of Corruption pg. 24
You can use your weapons to mar your opponents’ most distinctive characteristics.

Prerequisites: Critical Focus, base attack bonus +11, worshiper of Lamashtu.

Benefit: Whenever you confirm a critical hit against an opponent, in addition to dealing critical damage as normal, you maim your target so much that it takes 2 points of Charisma damage and becomes staggered for 1 round.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 24
When you confirm a critical hit against an opponent, you can spend 4 stamina points to increase the Charisma damage that opponent takes from Destroy Identity to 1d3+1 points.
